name: wpf-increment
description: Sub-recipe: one background semantic click on Increment, checked against the fixture's label.
notes: Sub-recipe: drives the counter by one, whatever state the window is in (works iconic and restored). It does not launch and does not minimize - wrappers do that. The counter is cumulative, so pass --var expected=<value+1> when the fixture has already been clicked; the check is a substring match on the label row.
